title.en: Introduction to the Economic Survey on Agriculture
title.hi: Introduction to the Economic Survey on Agriculture

content.en: The **Economic Survey on Agriculture** serves as a comprehensive health report of the agrarian sector, presented annually just ahead of the **Union Budget**. Within the broader framework of the **Indian Economy**, this document assesses agricultural growth rates, capital formation, institutional credit availability, food management, and allied sector performance. For **UPSC GS-3**, analyzing the Survey enables aspirants to move beyond static textbook knowledge and engage with dynamic policy shifts, productivity trends, and structural bottlenecks.
